feeds.title: Elite Medical Prep Blog
feeds.description: The #1 destination for medical school information resources! Find articles written by professional tutors about exam prep, residency & more. Elite Medical Prep is the premier online tutoring service for the USMLE, COMLEX, NBME, ABIM, and related medical exams. We provide the highest quality tutoring for these high-stakes exams.

feeds.title: Blueprint Prep » USMLE
feeds.description: Blueprint is a learning platform disrupting the professional training and education industry with one simple idea: students learn more when they are having fun. Our team of innovators creates the most engaging video lectures, personalized study planning tools, and adaptive learning technology. Read about maximizing performance, the use of flashcards while studying, how to prepare, and more on our blog.

feeds.title: First Aid Team
feeds.description: The First Aid/USMLE-Rx Blog was created to address a need for students to have a single, official source for all updates and errata to each edition of the First Aid series, including First Aid for the USMLE Step 1. The blog is also intended to provide information, advice, and assistance to help students prepare for their exams.

feeds.title: Board Vitals Blog » USMLE
feeds.description: BoardVitals is a physician-run company that covers many of the board and certification exams for Physicians, Nurses, Dentists, Technicians, and Pharmacists. Check out our blog to know more about board exams, practice questions, what's next, and more.

feeds.title: USMLE World Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to USMLE world. Hope you find something useful here! Akshee Batra, the owner of the USMLE World Blog is a doctor, traveler, foodie, coffee lover, fashion newbie, and Wine-taster. It's a blog for IMGs by an IMG.

feeds.title: Med Learnity » USMLE
feeds.description: Med Learnity pride itself on offering the highest quality medical tutoring and consulting in the industry, which starts with our incredibly accomplished, experienced, and compassionate tutors who deeply care about student success. In our blog, you can find insights into the life of a med student, USMLE preparation knowledge, and more.

feeds.title: UWorld Medical Blog
feeds.description: At UWorld, we build exceptional content that makes the really hard stuff easy to understand. We reduce complexity in our explanations and our delivery to benefit students. The UWorld Medical Blog provides aspiring medical students with relevant information on the USMLE® Step exams, board exams, the latest updates in medical education, and other valuable insights on the journey from medical school to clinical practice.

feeds.title: Amboss Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2012, AMBOSS is driven by its mission to empower all doctors to provide the best possible care. It aims to serve those pursuing medicine as well as those already in the field as an extensive medical knowledge resource. Read all the latest posts on AMBOSS updates, study tips, and industry news.

feeds.title: Lecturio Student Blog
feeds.description: At Lecturio, our mission is to provide students and faculty with the best learning tools, proven effective by learning science. We have created a high-quality digital medical education resource, which is affordable, adaptive, and personalized. We are very proud to offer you a great variety of comprehensive high quality online medical courses that cover all important medical fields and disciplines and are held by award-winning educators.

feeds.title: USMLE Strike Blog
feeds.description: We at USMLE Strike precisely adopt unique strategies in our educational process to ensure that every student here enjoys learning syllable knowledge along with acquiring wisdom for life. Our mission is to provide comprehensive solutions for every medical candidate at various steps in the maze of medical education.
